answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 380 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the cedar challenge, the vine audit can replay the vault history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3635 identities would post 4930 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
